review_scope: Read-only source review and deterministic AST fingerprint calculation; no implementation-equivalence or finite-model claim for changed unmodeled families.

updates.semantic_review: The pre-send preparation block now catches BaseException and marks model_sent=False, including unknown reservation commit or capture-file publication failures. It does not infer reservation rollback, remove durable reservations, or retry; post-send finish behavior remains unchanged and is not proven by this update.

Request construction and reserve failures are explicitly known-unsent; usage is extracted before content decoding, and response/postflight failures retain observed usage and physical identity through the shared helper. No new send/retry path is added; physical reserve/finish atomicity is unchanged.

Delegates cumulative projection through _review_summary so the same reviewed-predecessor policy is reusable by status_snapshot; base implementation is identity. This is a read-only derived-state projection, not a physical request transition.

Keeps predecessor validation and delegates to the base projection; reviewed UNKNOWN subtraction and REVIEWED_UNKNOWN projection moved to _review_summary, which must receive its own binding. Operator review is not provider completion and does not erase unknown reservations.

Both existing budget-limit refusals now carry model_sent=False. Locking, admission arithmetic and pending-reservation mutation are unchanged; this supports zero attempted-send accounting rather than changing physical budget authority.

Tracks whether a provider result was actually observed; post-result failures preserve usage/identity and normalized failure facts in call_record. Existing finally settlement and cache-confirmation structure remain. RPC result loss remains unknown, not a fabricated physical send or zero usage.

Now a dispatch-fact wrapper around new _execute. Initial false denotes handler not entered; wire_read/wire_cancel start unknown because they may refer to an earlier invocation. Preserve original exception and attach request_dispatched; bind the extracted transition body separately.

Direct and chunked logical calls use new _dispatch to distinguish endpoint-proven pre-handler rejection from entered/unknown RPC. Download failure is not recast as known-unsent, and no request replay is added. Bind _dispatch separately.

Any failure of the pre-send admission snapshot is marked model_sent=False; existing expected failures retain the public admission error, while unexpected storage/error types are re-raised. Persistent permission-block and acknowledgment transitions do not change.

Explicit model_sent=False takes precedence over status/cause heuristics and is classified admission/nonretryable/ERROR. Unchanged ToolExecutor and transport call sites consume this changed classifier semantically; unchanged call-site hashes must not be refreshed.

Pending token removal/confirmation behavior is unchanged; model failure serialization delegates to canonical model_errors.error_details, retaining observed usage, original code and send facts instead of a partial hand-written field copy.

semantic_obligations: Keep reservation-commit uncertainty independent from physical model send. model_sent=False may coexist with STARTED/pending reservation after COMMIT_UNKNOWN; do not release or replay that reservation.
RPC handler dispatch True alone supplies no physical-send proof. Canonical model_errors.error_details only derives false from dispatched=False; preserve its unknown default for entered/lost RPC.
Known response usage must survive decoding, output validation, cache publication and public JSON errors; missing/invalid usage remains unavailable rather than zero.

Readonly status_snapshot/_budget_status adds unavailable current/cumulative projections with nulls and BLOCKED; operator review leaves UNKNOWN and reservation intact. Current and cumulative facts are independent.
PR31 moves canonical error normalization from llm_contract to model_errors; presend extensions must extend existing ERROR_FIELDS, not recreate a second normalizer.
When presend model is registered, protect model_errors ERROR_FIELDS via a module binding or dedicated AST field rule: function-only bindings do not detect constant tuple edits.
